text:
anya: opened a PR to add the novum9b model card + migration notes for SDK v4 snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/4872 — this adds supported variants, quant profiles, seq limits, and a short throughput benchmark section. please skim.

mike: thanks! can you include microbench numbers (p50/p95 tokens/sec) for the 16k sequence profile? QA wants ballpark figures.

anya: added a small bench table in the PR — p50 220 tok/s @A100-80GB, p95 165 tok/s. also noted variance when dynamic padding is enabled (up to ~15% lower throughput).

rio: tiny schema nit: the model-card yaml uses `max_sequence` but our catalog schema expects `max_sequence_length`. will cause the lint to fail. plz update.

anya: good catch, updated the key to `max_sequence_length` and pushed.

samir: also could we get a short python streaming snippet + an embedding fallback example? Something like:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = c.generate(model="novum9b", input="hello world", stream=True)
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

and an embeddings fallback note for small VMs. call out the `variant` param (e.g. `variant=\"sparse-lite\"`).

anya: added both snippets and linked them to the SDK-4 migration guide. used `variant=\"sparse-lite\"` in the streaming example and showed a fallback pattern for embeddings when GPU is unavailable.

jenna: one small link fix: the quant profile anchor 404s — should link to `#quantization-profiles` not `#quant-profiles`.

docs-bot: deploy preview build passed ✅ (staging). Preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4872

mike: can eng-ml sign off on the compatibility note for CPU-quant fallback? @samir can you confirm latency / quality callouts? :thumbsup:

samir: reviewed and added language: on 4GB CPU VMs prefer `quant_profile: int8` or `cpu-quant` fallback; note that CPU fallback may increase latency by 2-3x and change small-token generation quality. included a short eval link to the bench results.

anya: thanks all — requested reviews from @mike @jenna @samir. plan to merge after one more approval and the anchor fix. leaving the PR description to include migration checklist + changelog entry. :rocket:
